## @interlace/reading-settings

Installed to `components/ui/reading-settings.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/reading-settings';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/reading-settings

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
